description: Lexical hallucination check: an LLM answer's words, numbers and polarity against the source. Deterministic, no API key. Each answer sentence is aligned to its best source sentence, so a number is support only on the SAME statement ("founded in 1998" is not grounded by "sold 1998 units"), and a negation or antonym flip against it returns verdict "contradicted". Lexical only: no paraphrase, synonym or multi-sentence reasoning, so "well_grounded" means nothing lexical was found, never "verified true". Entailment: run_semantic_tests (NLI/embedding) or a calibrated judge.

examples.answer: Le remboursement prend plus de 7 jours ouvrés.
examples.context: Le remboursement prend plus de 7 jours ouvrés.

answer.description: The LLM answer to verify (with context).

cases.description: Batch instead of answer + context: one result per case, and the worst gate overall.

context.description: The source text that should ground it.

strict.description: Every sentence must be supported (default false).

name: hallucination_check
